answer: To join, an agent must map its token onto the atlas of registered samples, proving one identity per token. Each agent stakes a bond anchored to a unique physical basalt token, like a signed mineral sample with serialized provenance. A comet-marked epoch rotates which tokens are audited, forcing attackers to acquire real samples; forging duplicates costs more than legitimate participation earns. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
